description: This file contains the startup assembly routine for a MIPS-based bootloader, specifically for a Linux kernel loader using LZMA compression on Atheros AR7XXX/AR9XXX platforms. It includes initialization of CPU registers, cache management, relocation of code, BSS segment clearing, and jumping to the decompressor routine.

methods.name: startup
methods.description: The entry point of the bootloader assembly, performing CPU init, cache setup, relocation, BSS clearing, stack setup, and jumping to the main loader routine.
